rationale: Visible evidence supports the assertion: SELECTOR_METRICS shows OrbitRepair-Proxy numerically ahead of CFC-only on top3 containment, cost-to-contain, and regret@3, while LoopCert/blend contenders only improve regret and do not beat CFC-only on cost-to-contain. The cited gate logic requires a LoopCert/blend contender to beat CFC-only on both regret@3 and cost-to-contain, and the claim ledger explicitly marks ce_selection_gate failed, so Stage10 should not claim CE-selector success over CFC-only.
